in0   <- eigenius_inputs[[1]]
val   <- .Call("r_eigon_f64_array", in0, "urn:eigenius:pub:wrn:viab_value")
guide <- .Call("r_eigon_str_array", in0, "urn:eigenius:pub:wrn:viab_guide")
df <- data.frame(value = val, guide = factor(guide), is_WRN = factor(grepl("WRN", guide)))
stopifnot(nrow(df) == 30L, nlevels(df$guide) == 5L, nlevels(df$is_WRN) == 2L)
library(lme4)
# Biological-level (pseudoreplication-corrected) competition-assay analysis (F4).
# The guide is the biological replication unit (3 sgWRN + 2 control); the 6 reps
# per guide are technical. Test the is_WRN fixed effect via an LRT of the full
# vs guide-only random-intercept model (REML=FALSE) -- the mixed-model
# counterpart of the authors' lm(value ~ is_WRN + guide) %>% anova(), which
# instead tested is_WRN against the technical within-guide residual.
m0 <- lmer(value ~ (1 | guide), df, REML = FALSE)
m1 <- lmer(value ~ is_WRN + (1 | guide), df, REML = FALSE)
pval <- anova(m0, m1)[["Pr(>Chisq)"]][2]
impaired <- mean(df$value[df$is_WRN == "TRUE"]) < mean(df$value[df$is_WRN == "FALSE"])
b <- .Call("r_eigon_begin", "urn:eigenius:pub:wrn:viab_KM12_bio_lme4:result")
.Call("r_eigon_add_class", b, "urn:eigenius:reflection:DerivedResource")
.Call("r_eigon_set_f64", b, "urn:eigenius:measurements:lrt_p_value", pval)
# A significant is_WRN effect with sgWRN viability below control, established at
# the biological unit, is the honest viability-dependence warrant (F4).
if (pval < 0.05 && impaired) {
  .Call("r_eigon_set_proposition", b,
        "urn:eigenius:benchmark:onco:ViabilityDependenceAtBiologicalUnit", c("WRN", "KM12"))
}
.Call("r_eigon_finish", b)
